m: अरा f. (= आरा), an awl Comm. on MBh. xv, 19.

v: arADas

tri॰ rADaH DananAma niru॰ । tannAsti yasya । Danarahite ‘kadAmarttamarADasam’ f॰ 1, 84, 8, “arADasam rADasA Danena rahitam” BA॰ ‘padA paRI~ rarADaso nibADasvaM f॰ 8, 61, 2 “arADasaM DanahInam yajYaYca” BA॰ ।
m: अ-राधस् mfn. not liberal, hard, stingy, selfish, RV. & AV.
a: अराधस् — a. [राधः; धनं- Nir. न. ब.] Poor, not able to perform sacrifices, stingy; hard.

m: अराण aor. p. √ ऋ, q.v.
अराणि or अरालि m. N. of a son of Viśvāmitra, MBh. xiii, 257.
अ-राद्धि f. ill-success, mischance, VS. xxx, 9.
a: अराद्धिः — f. Transgression, sin, offence; envy.

v: arAga
pu॰ aBAve na॰ । 1 anurAgABAve raYjanABAve ca na॰ ba॰ । 2 rAgaSUnye tri॰ । “tamahamarAgamatfzRam” veRI॰
m: अ-राग mfn. unimpassioned, cool, Veṇīs.
a: अराग, अरागिन् — a. Cool, dispassionate; तमहमरागमकृष्णं कृष्णद्वैपायनं वंदे Ve. 1. 4.

m: अ-राग-द्वेष (in comp.)
अ-राग-द्वेष—तस् ind. not from passion or anger, Bhag.
अ-राग-द्वे—˚षिन् mfn. neither loving nor hating, Viṣṇ.

v: arAgin
tri॰ na rAgI na॰ ta॰ । virakte striyAM NIp ।
m: अ-रागिन् mfn. id.
not coloured, Suśr.
अरागि-ता f. indifference with regard to (loc.), Sāh.
अ-राजान्वयिन् mfn. not belonging to the family of a king, Rājat.

v: arAjIva
pu॰ aram cakrANgaM tatsADanam AjIvati A + jova an upa॰ sa॰ । 1 raTakAre । rAjIvaM padmam na॰ ba॰ । 3 padmaSUnye jalAdO tri॰ ।

s: tri, (nAsti rAjA yatra saH, kap .) rAjaSUnyadeSAdiH । yaTA, -- “cOraprAyaM janapadaM hInasatvamarAjakaM” । iti SrIBAgavataM ॥ (niyantfhInaH । SAsanakartfrahitaH । “arAjake janapade dozA jAyanti vE sadA । udvfttaM satataM lokaM rAjA daRqena SAsti vE” ॥ iti mahABArate .)
puM, (nAsti rAjA yatra saH kap .) rAjaSUnyadeSAdiH । yaTA, -- “arAjake hi loke'smin sarvvatI vidrute BayAt । rakzArTamasya sarvvasya rAjAnamasfjat praBuH” ॥ iti mAnave 7 aDyAye 3 SlokaH ॥
v: arAjaka
tri॰ nAsti rAjA yatra kap । rAjaSUnye deSAdO “arAjako hi loko'smin sarvvato vidrute BayAt” manuH ।
m: अ-राजक mfn. having no king, TBr. &c.
अ-राजक n. want of a king, anarchy, BhP.
a: अराजक — a. Having no king, anarchical; नाराजके जनपदे Rām.; Ms. 7. 3; अराजके जीवलोके दुर्बला वलवत्तरैः . पीड्यंते न हि वित्तेषु प्रभुत्वं कस्यचित्तदा .. Mb.; शोच्यं राज्यमराजकं Chāṇ. 57.

m: अ-राजन् आ, m. not a king, ŚBr. & AitBr.
a: अराजन् — m. Not a king. --Comp. --भोगीन a. not fit for the use of a king. --स्थापित a. not established by a king, illegal.

v: arAjanya
pu॰ na॰ ta॰ । kzatriyaBinne “rAjYo na DanamanvicCedarAjanyaprasUtitaH” manuH ।
m: अ-राजन्य mfn. without the Rājanya-or Kṣatriya-caste, ŚBr.
अराज-ता f. the want of a king, AitBr.

v: arAjin

tri॰ rAjA aDizWAtftvenAstyasya brIhyA॰ ini na॰ ta॰ । 1 rAjAnaDizWite “vi parvvatAH arAjinaH” f॰ 1, 7, 23 । arAjinaH rAjYA kenacitsvAminA 'naGizWitAH” BA॰ । na rAjate rAja--ini । 2 dIptiSUnye tri॰ striyAmuBayato NIp ।
m: अ-राजिन् mfn. without splendour, RV. viii, 7, 23.
a: अराजिन् — a. Ved. Unchecked, unrestrained, or without splendour.

m: अ-राक्षस mfn. freed from Rākṣasas, MBh.

s: strI, (arAla + striyAM wAp) aDfzwA । kulawA । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
m: अराला f. (g. बह्व्-आदि, q.v.) a disloyal or unchaste woman, L.
a modest woman, L.
अराली f. (g. बह्व्-आदि, q.v.) a disloyal or unchaste woman, L.
a modest woman, L.

s: tri, (f + vic, aramAlAti, A + lA + ka .) kuwilaM । vakraM । ityamaraH ॥ (“arAlEH svABAvyAdalikaraBakaSrIBiralakEH” । iti AnandalaharI .)
puM, (f + vic, aramAlAti, A + lA + ka .) sarjjarasaH । mattahastI । iti medinI ॥ vakrahastaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
v: arAla

pu॰ f--vic aramAlAti A + lA--ka । 1 sarjjarase 2 mattahastini । 3 kuwile tri॰ । “tatrAmarAlayamarAlamarAlakeSI” nEza॰ “BittvA nirAkrAmadarAlakeSyAH” raGuH “novaktramAtmIyamarAlapakzmaRaH” kumA॰ । 4 veSyAyAM strI
m: अराल mfn. (cf. अर, fr. √ ऋ; Intens. for अरार?), crooked, curved, Uttarar. (अन्- neg. ‘straight’), &c.
crisped or curled (as hair), Ragh. &c.
(g. शार्ङ्गरवादि, q.v.) ‘Crispus’, N. of a Vedic teacher, VBr.
अराल m. a bent or crooked arm or hand, L.
अराल the resin of the plant Shorea Robusta, L.
अराल m. an elephant in rut, L.
a: अराल — a. [ऋ-विच् अरं आलाति, लाक] Spreading like the spokes of a wheel, curved, crooked; पादावरालांगुली M. 2. 3. --लः 1 A bent or crooked arm. --2 The resin of the plant Shorea Robusta (सर्जरस). --3 An elephant in rut. --ला 1 An unchaste woman, harlot, courtezan. --2 A modest woman (अधृष्टा). --Comp. --केशी a woman with curled hair; भित्त्वा निराक्रामदरालकेश्याः R. 6. 81. --पक्ष्मन् a. having curved eyelashes; Ku. 5. 49.

k.v: अरालं वृजिनं जिह्ममूर्मिमत्कुञ्चितं नतम्. आविद्धं कुटिलं भुग्नं वेल्लितं वक्रमित्यपि॥

m: अराल—हस्त m. a partic. position of the hands, Cat.
अराल—केशी f. a woman with curled hair, Ragh.
अराल—पक्ष्म-नयन mfn. whose eyelashes are curved, N. xi, 33.
अरालि v.l. for अराणि, q.v.
अरान्तर n. pl. the intervals of the spokes.
अरान्तर-गता f. (with नाभि) N. of a mythical place, Divyāv.
अराड mf(ई)n. (= उच्छ्रित-शृङ्ग) having high horns, MaitrS.
(compar. of fem. ˚दीतर), ŚBr. iv.
अराड m. N. of a Muni, Bcar.
अराड्य mfn. id., TS.

v: arAtIvan
tri॰ arAtimicCati vede matvarToyovanip pUrvvapadadIrGaSca । SatrutulyAcAravati । “aGAyurarAtIvA marcayati dvayena” f॰ 1, 147, 4 ।
m: अराती-वन् mfn. hostile, inimical, RV.
a: अरातीवन् — a. Not offering; unfriendly, malicious, hostile, inimical.

m: अरातीय Nom. P. ˚तीयति (p. ˚तीयत् [RV. i, 99, 1, &c.]; Subj. ˚तीयात्), Ved. id.

a: अरातीयत् — a. Not offering, unfriendly, malicious, acting like an enemy.

v: arAtIyu
tri॰ arAtiriva Acarati arAti + kyac--u । aTa॰ 10, 6, 1 । SatrutulyAcAraSIle “arAtIyorBrAtfvyasya durhfdaH”
m: अरातीयु mfn. hostile, AV. x, 6, 1.
a: अरातीयु — a. Ved. Not accustomed to offer; inimical.

s: puM, (na rAti dadAti suKaM, rA + ktic, naYsamAsaH .) SatruH । ityamaraH ॥ (“arAtivikramAlokavikasvaravilocanaH” । iti sAhityadarpaRe । “anekayudDavijayI sanDAnaM yasya gacCati । tatpraBAvena tasyASu vaSaM gacCantyarAtayaH” ॥ iti paYcatantre .)
v: arAti

pu॰ na rAti dadAti suKaM rA + ktic na॰ ta॰ । 1 SatrO । “deSaH, so'yamarAtiSoRitajalEryasmin hradAH pUritAH” veRI॰ ariSabde vivftiH । jyotizokte 2 zazWasTAne । “ArativraRayoH zazWe azwame mftyuranDrayoH” ityakteH zazWasTAne arikftaSuBASuBacintanIyayatvAttaTAtvam kAmAdizvAntararipuzu 4 zawsaMKyAyAM kAmAdInAmAntararipURAM saMKyAsAmyAt । 5 aBigamanaSIle ca “mA GAnyaryovanuzAmarAtayaH” f॰ 7, 83, 5, । “viSvA agnO arAtIH f॰ 8, 49, 2, arAtIH aBigamanaSIlAH SatravovA BA॰ BAve ktin aBAve na॰ ta॰ । 6 dAnAmAve strI “mA no arAtirISata” f॰ 2, 7, 2 । “arAtiradAnam SatrurvA vede SatrO arAtiSabdaH strI” BA॰ । arAtirivAcarati । AtmanaH aramicCati kyac arAtIyati । Satrutulyamacarati tadicCati yetyarTe । “ya ukta yajamane yArAtIyati” Sata॰ vrA॰ । yo'smaByamarAtIyAt” yaju॰ 11, 80 ।
m: अ-राति f. ‘non liberality’, enviousness, malignity, RV.
failure, adversity, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; TBr.
particular evil spirits (who frustrate the good intentions and disturb the happiness of man), ib.
अ-राति (इस्), m. an enemy, Ragh. xii, 89
(in arithm.) the number six (there being six sins or internal enemies, cf. षड्-वर्ग).
a: अरातिः — [न राति ददाति सुखं, रा-क, न. त.] 1 An enemy, foe; देशः सोयमरातिशोणितजलैर्यस्मिन्ह्रदाः पूरिताः Ve. 3. 31; (in the Veda) non-offering (of sacrifices), stinginess, hardness, malignity, malevolence, failure or adversity; malignity personified; evil spirit whose aim it was to defeat the good intentions and disturb the happiness of man (used in f.). --2 The number six. --3 The sixth position (in astronomy). --Comp. --दूषण, --दूषि, --ह a. Ved. destroying adversities or enemies. --भंगः destruction of enemies.

m: अ-राति—भङ्ग m. defeat of a foe, L.
अ-राति—दूषण mfn. destroying adversity, AV. xix, 34, 4.
अ-राति—दूषि mfn. id., AV. ii, 4, 6.
अ-राति—ह mfn. = -दूषण, q.v., AV. xix, 35, 2.
अ-राति—नुद् mfn. expelling enemies, MBh. iii, 1702.
अरातिय Nom. P. (Subj. ˚त्स्यात्) to be malevolent, have hostile intentions against (dat.), AV. iv, 36, 1.

a: अराति(ती)यति — Den. P. Ved. To desire not to offer; to act like an enemy, act maliciously.

v: arAvan
tri॰ rA--vanip na॰ ta॰ । adAtari । “arAvA cana martyaH” f॰ 8, 8, 4, ‘pAhiDUrtterarAvRaH, f॰ 1, 36, 15 striyAM NIp vanoraSca । arAvarI ।
m: 1. अ-रावन् mfn. ‘not liberal’, envious, hostile, RV.
2. अरावन् m. = अर्वन्, a steed, horse [NBD.; = अर-वत्, ‘having spokes or wheels, a cart’, Ludwig. = गमन-वत्, ‘moving’, Sāy.], RV. vii, 68, 7.
a: अरावन् — a. Ved. Not offering malignant, epithet of evil spirits.

m: अराटकी f. N. of a plant, AV. iv, 37, 6.
a kind of plant, AV.
a: अराटकी — Ved. N. of the plant अजशृंगी.

m: अ-रायी f. id., RV. x, 555, 1 and 2; AV.

v: arAya

tri॰ nAsti rA DanaM yasya vede zacsamA॰ । 1 DanaSUnye striyAM NIz ॥ “apamfjya vA yAtuDAnAnapa sarvvA arAyyaH” aya॰ 4, 18, 8 rA + BAve GaY rAyoyajYAdOdAnam na॰ ba॰ । 2 tacCUnye tri॰ । “nArAyAso na jvahlavaH” f॰ 8 । 61 । 11, “arAyAH aDanAH ahavizkA vA” BA॰ “arAyeByojiGatsuBya imaM me parirakzata” aTa॰ 8, 2, 20 ।
m: अ-राय mfn. id., RV. viii, 61, 11 (Nir. vi, 25)
अ-राय m. an evil spirit, AV.
a: अराय — a. [नास्ति राधनं यस्य वेदे षच्समासः] 1 Devoid of wealth, without sacrificial gifts. --2 Stingy, niggardly. --यः, --यी Any malignant or evil spirit.

m: अ-राय—चातन n. id., ib.
अ-राय—क्षयण n. anything that serves to destroy evil spirits, AV. ii, 18, 3.
अ-राष्ट्र अम्, and n. not a kingdom, ŚBr.
a: अराष्ट्रं — Loss of royal power or sovereignty.
